description: Runtime layout for the kumi shared-state and observability files. The hooks read these names, so you can rename or relocate any of them here without touching hook code. All paths are relative to state_dir, which defaults to .kumi in the working project. Set the KUMI_STATE_DIR environment variable to move that base directory: an absolute path keeps state in one place across projects, a relative path is taken from the project root. Hooks write into a state directory only after kumi is called in that project, and rules in overrides.json apply only after the user confirms the file; both records are kept in the plugin data directory, outside the project. The model section is read by scripts/build_agents.py, not by the hooks.
